sections.description: Increase your affiliate link clicks & affiliate revenue by highlighting your affiliate links on the page[cite: 9]. Full Lifetime Pro edition featuring unlimited highlighters, custom hex colors, and scroll-triggered Focus Mode blur[cite: 7].
